name: orchestr
description: Local-first engineering control room for projects, tasks, and workers.

scripts.crap:ts: npm run test:coverage && npm run crap --workspace @orchestr/desktop
scripts.crap:rust: node scripts/prepare-crap-output.mjs && cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path target/crap/lcov.info && cargo crap --workspace --lcov target/crap/lcov.info --exclude build.rs --baseline .cargo-crap-baseline.json --format json --output target/crap/rust-crap.json && node scripts/check-rust-crap.mjs
scripts.crap:rust:baseline: node scripts/prepare-crap-output.mjs && cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path target/crap/lcov.info && cargo crap --workspace --lcov target/crap/lcov.info --exclude build.rs --format json --sort file --output .cargo-crap-baseline.json
scripts.crap: npm run crap:ts && npm run crap:rust
